subject: NorthStar pilot: on-prem operational safeguards & commercial ask — exec approval request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northstar.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthStar pilot: on-prem operational safeguards and commercial ask

Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to run a short on-prem pilot (non-production) with Redwood to validate latency and model footprint inside our environment. A few specific asks from our security and procurement teams that will determine whether we can move forward with the April pilot window: 

1) Limited maintenance access: we need a timeboxed SSH maintenance channel (30 days) for Redwood engineers during onboarding. Access must be jump-hosted, IP allowlist only.
2) Logs: audit logs for the pilot to be retained for 12 months (we understand your default is 90 days).
3) Audit rights: quarterly read-only audits for the pilot (remote observation preferred), with a two-week notice.
4) KMS/HSM: we plan to manage keys in our KMS; would need confirmation your runtime supports customer-managed KMS and key rotation.
5) Commercial: to move quickly we are asking for a 15% prepay discount for the 3-month pilot and an operational credit if onboarding takes longer than agreed.

Attached is a one-page compliance rationale from our security team that explains the ask in context. Can you confirm whether these are negotiable and what would be needed from your side to get to a signed SOW by March 22?

Appreciate quick reaction — pilot target April 10.

— Lena
[attachment: NorthStar_Compliance_Rationale.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northstar.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar pilot: on-prem operational safeguards and commercial ask

Lena — thanks for the clarity and the doc. We can partner on a timeboxed onboarding model that meets your security needs, but a couple of items will require internal approvals (audit window, log retention, and the commercial concession).

Proposed mutual action plan (brief):
- Week of 3/15: internal security + legal review (we'll loop in our cloud ops team).
- By 3/18: Redwood to circulate a redline SOW with proposed mitigations (jump-host, IP allowlist, limited SSH window).
- By 3/22: target for signatures to lock April 10 pilot.

I'll kick off an internal thread to get security and legal alignment. For the commercial ask — can you share which part of the prepay is critical (percent of pilot fee) and any procurement contract template we should be aware of?

Attaching a short MAP I use to keep SOWs simple.

— Sofia
[attachment: MAP_NorthStar_pilot-v1.docx (docx)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NorthStar pilot: on-prem operational safeguards and commercial ask

Team — forwarding NorthStar's asks. Quick digest: 30-day SSH window (jump host + allowlist), 12-month log retention (vs our baseline 90 days), quarterly read-only audits with 2-week notice, customer KMS, and 15% prepay discount for pilot.

What I need: security to outline mitigations and whether a 12-month retention is acceptable; legal to suggest contract language for audit scope; deal desk / sales leadership to confirm discount band we can approve vs what needs exec signoff. NorthStar is timeboxed — they want a decision by 3/22.

Attached is our current proposal draft (pricing & SOW).

Thanks — Marissa
[attachment: redwood_proposal_draft.pdf (pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar pilot - security assessment (initial)

Marissa / team — initial stance: we can accept a timeboxed SSH channel for onboarding under these controls:
- Access only via a hardened jump host; allowlist to specific NorthStar IPs and our ops IPs
- MFA + short-lived keys (ephemeral agent) for any maintenance sessions
- Packet capture / deep packet inspection disabled; no full pcap allowed
- Audit logging of any maintenance session, immutable audit trail stored encrypted

12 months of log retention is longer than our standard — security risk increases exposure window. If legal accepts scoping and redaction rules, security can sign off provided NorthStar agrees to: (a) minimize PII in logs via hashing/anonymization; (b) accept that logs are only used for the pilot scope; (c) Redwood retains right to truncate after 12 months unless otherwise agreed by execs.

Commercial note: standard discretionary concession for pilots is up to 10% from Deal Desk; anything above 10% will need VP/exec approval. Recommend we prepare a 12% concession as a compromise to close quickly and seek exec approval for >10% ASAP.

— Karthik
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar pilot - proposed legal language

Team — attached is a redline for the audit clause that balances customer observation with Redwood's need to protect operational details. Key terms:
- Audits limited to quarterly during pilot, remote observation preferred; 14 days' notice required.
- Auditors may observe read-only console access or livestream; no direct administrative access.
- Redwood to be present for any remote session and may redact any output that exposes platform internals or other customers.
- Logs provided for review must be hashed/anonymized; PII removed.
- Indemnity limited and damage cap tied to pilot fees.

Commercial/legal recommendation: authorize a one-time 12% discount for the pilot and allow customer-managed KMS (no escrow of keys) — if NorthStar insists on HSM escrow or unconstrained packet capture, we decline. Anything beyond 12% or any HSM escrow request requires exec signoff.

Attached: audit_clause_redline.docx

— Dev
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — NorthStar pilot concessions (time-sensitive)

Ben / Laura —

Requesting urgent exec approval to proceed on the NorthStar pilot with the following negotiated concessions: 

- Commercial: 12% prepay discount for the 3-month pilot (they asked 15%; our Deal Desk max without exec is 10%).
- Access: 30-day SSH maintenance window for onboarding only, via hardened jump host and IP allowlist.
- Logs: pilot log retention = 12 months (our default 90 days) with mandatory hashing/anonymization and usage restrictions in contract.
- Audit: quarterly, remote, read-only observation with 14 days' notice; Redwood to attend and may redact platform-internal details.
- KMS: customer-managed keys allowed (no escrow); keys not to be held by Redwood.

We will not agree to HSM escrow, full packet capture, or unfettered admin access. Legal has redlined the audit language (attached) and Security has conditionally approved the controls above.

Business rationale: NorthStar is a strategic mid-market prospect for healthcare inference; closing pilot on April 10 opens a path to a committed Dedicated deployment H2. They will sign quickly if we can meet the above and provide the 12% concession. If we cannot finalize by 3/22 they will delay to May and likely test a competitor.

Ask: please confirm approval of the above concessions and the one-time 12% prepay discount. If approved, instruct Deal Desk to finalize SOW and prepare a DocuSign envelope.

Attaching the final proposal for exec review.

— Sofia
[attachment: final_proposal_for_exec_review.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-17T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — NorthStar pilot concessions (time-sensitive)

Sofia — approved.

I authorize the one-time 12% prepay discount and acceptance of the operational exceptions as outlined (30-day SSH window, 12-month hashed log retention limited to pilot scope, quarterly remote audits with 14 days' notice). Legal to include an indemnity cap equivalent to the pilot fees. Security to require jump-host + allowlist + ephemeral keys as conditions.

Deal Desk: please update the SOW and generate a DocuSign envelope. Priority: get signed by 3/22 to keep the April 10 pilot start.

— Ben
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northstar.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-17T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar pilot: on-prem operational safeguards and commercial ask

Sofia — fantastic, thank you and please convey our appreciation to your team. We accept the 12% prepay discount and the described controls. Please send the DocuSign envelope and final SOW; procurement will sign within 48 hours.
